Bill.BriefDescription: Providing additional protections for safe residential housing for persons with developmental disabilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to safe residential housing for persons withdevelopmental disabilities; and adding a new section to chapter 43.43RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For purposes of this section, "community protection program"means a program, established and implemented by the department ofsocial and health services' division of developmental disabilities,designed to provide safe residential facilities to persons withdevelopmental disabilities who: (a) Have been convicted of, found notguilty by reason of insanity of, or found to be incompetent to standtrial for, a sex offense, as defined by RCW 9.94A.030; or (b)constitute a current risk to others, as determined by a qualifiedprofessional. (2)(a) A person seeking to work at a facility that is part of thecommunity protection program shall submit a full set of fingerprints tothe Washington state patrol to be used to conduct a national criminalhistory background check. p. 1 SB 6824 (b) The Washington state patrol shall submit the fingerprints ofthe prospective community protection program worker to the federalbureau of investigation or to such other entity necessary to conduct anational criminal history background check. (3) The secretary of the department of social and health servicesshall determine what criminal history shall prohibit a person fromworking at a community protection program facility. (4) This section applies to all prospective employees, volunteers,and independent contractors who are likely to have unsupervised accessto residents of a community protection program facility.
